role: post-primary robustness of specialization architecture against pooled-population baselines

design.self_predictor: same individual's other eligible sessions within the exact admitted cohort
design.alternative_predictor: one alternative individual at a time within the exact admitted cohort
design.aggregation: equal alternatives within target session, equal sessions within individual, equal individuals in panel

predictions.hypsignathus: conditional pairwise gain and conditional self-win fraction should exceed marginal counterparts if place-coupled architecture is not a pooling artefact
predictions.phyllostomus_2022: marginal pairwise gain should exceed conditional pairwise gain if the altitude-wide architecture is not a pooling artefact
predictions.phyllostomus_2023: reported descriptively as temporal robustness; no rescue criterion

claim_boundary: cannot redefine any frozen species-level replication result
vertical flight-use organization only; foraging state not inferred
